big: An index fund aims to match an index, minus costs. It does not try to beat it. In large caps many active funds have struggled to beat the index after costs. In mid and small caps, active has more room, though nothing is guaranteed.

lines: No. Passive has low cost, transparency and no manager risk. But it falls fully with the market and cannot avoid overvalued stocks. Use passive where markets are efficient and cost matters. Use active where a manager's process can add value. Always judge by the client's needs.
